title: Tenant quiesce window and staggered reinstate for regional failover stabilization (hotfix)
author: Aisha Romero
description: Context: During a regional transient last week we observed correlated tenant reopen storms when region health probes flapped; simultaneous reinstate attempts caused KV cache churn and surge-evictions that amplified SLO breaches. Motivation: introduce a short, tenant-scoped "quiesce window" on region failover that serializes reinstate attempts with jittered backoff and a staggered-reinstate coordinator. This reduces bursty rejoin traffic and gives the serving runtime time to warm KV caches and stabilize before accepting full traffic. What this PR does: 1) Add a tenant_quiesce_window (default 30s) to the failover coordinator that marks tenants as "quiesced" on an outbound region handoff. 2) Implement a staggered reinstate scheduler that assigns reinstate slots using tenant weight and historical request rate. 3) Add a soft circuit coalescer that prevents immediate circuit resets for tenants that rejoin within the quiesce window. 4) Expose two new metrics (quiesce.window_applied, reinstate.slot_latency) and a debug-only trace path. 5) Hotfixes in the runtime to avoid duplicate KV drain on simultaneous reinstate. Rollout plan: feature gate off by default -> rollout to canary region -> metric validation -> global enable. Related work: ENG-1298 (regional failover stabilization), SUP-4983 (customer incident #42). Checklist: - [x] design doc review - [x] unit & integration tests - [x] added observability - [x] documented rollout and rollback path - [x] smoke test on canary region Testing: unit tests for scheduler, integration test simulating 200 tenant rejoin events, manual canary run. Backwards compatibility: default gate off; no tenant-visible config changes unless enabled by ops. Notes: This is a targeted hotfix for the immediate incident; follow-ups planned to tune slot heuristics and add adaptive windowing.
commits: feat(coordinator): implement staggered reinstate scheduler and slot assignment
fix(runtime): avoid duplicate KV drain on reinstate path
chore(tests): add reinstate scheduler unit tests and integration harness
docs(playbook): add quiesce window rollout and rollback steps
review_thread: Markus Chen: Please expose a per-tenant metric for "quiesce_applied" count; we need to correlate with SLO breaches. A: Added quiesce.window_applied metric and tag by tenant_id (see metrics.go).

Priya Patel: The reinstate slot allocation algorithm seems O(n^2) for large tenant lists; can we make it linear? A: Reworked allocation to use a single-pass reservoir-like assigner; added benchmarks (revised commit).
Diego Alvarez: Integration tests flaked once on CI (race in KV drain). A: Fixed with a mutex and deterministic test hooks; re-ran CI and confirmed stability.
release_notes: Hotfix: Add tenant quiesce window (default 30s) and staggered reinstate to reduce rejoin storms during regional failovers; adds observability and config under feature gate.
